_doc: Forja viva (docs/gdd/03b_diversion_y_ritmo.md §3b.2, O-D1, O-D4): forging a piece by hand as three decisions (heat, strikes, quench) while the cycle runs. Only whoever the player controls, only in mode "live" and only recipes listed in `recipes`. Employees and AI families never use it. Quality: the table of 4.4.2 read with the real craft (as mode normal, the same rolls), then + steps_all_right with the three decisions right, - steps_wrong with wrong_for_penalty or more wrong ones. Each decision is right, near (neither right nor wrong) or wrong; one not taken counts as near. heat: the colour pulled (heat_colors in order; the right one is right, a neighbour is near, the rest and `burnt` are wrong). strikes: one kind per strike (strike_kinds), as many as the template; all equal = right, one off = near, more = wrong. quench: the medium (quench_media); the right one (or the contract's spec temper, §3b.3) = right, any other = wrong. grace_hours: a cycle that ends with decisions left waits that long for them, then resolves with what was decided. A live cycle repeats in live only if the last one was played to the end (quench); else the next one is normal. masterwork: with craft >= min_craft and the three right, a roll of `chance` makes a named masterwork (excellent, in the chronicle). hint_craft: from it the screen says «ya casi» one colour before the right one; template_craft: from it the strike template is seen before striking. traits: what the decisions give the piece (descriptive until durability exists). patrons: the saints of the masterwork names (masterwork.patron.<id>). [balance] figures.
_variants_doc: §3b.3 (O-D5): the variants a contract's spec may ask for. recipe_axes: which axes a recipe chooses (temper, the quench, is always there). variants.<axis>.<value>: duration_mult of the cycle and strikes_add (strikes appended to the template in live). [balance]
